notes.title: The Capstone Update
notes.content:
[h3]The Capstone Update[/h3]

Hey Mages,

This update wraps up the improvements that we planned post-1.0. Today's release focuses on improving performance, UI tweaks and fixes, and a lot of small improvements that make everyday play smoother.

[h3]Capstone Update Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performance and stability. Reduced framerate stutter tied to large stockpiles, fewer ways for tasks to deadlock, and cleaner edge cases around rifts and pathfinding.

[*] Clearer signals when something’s wrong. A new icon flags doors that can’t be used because they aren’t on a floor or foundation, alerts appear when a mage is at death’s door and you don’t have any usable medical beds, and bed “unreachable” warnings are easier to understand.

[*] Pathing and room logic. Better detection for Private rooms (even with stairs through corners), a new Public Room keyword, and fixes for rare cases where Underschool rooms could end up blocked.

[*] Readability and guidance. The Codex text is larger, search is more reliable, ritual entries and costs are corrected, hover links behave like links, potion selection always fits on screen, and XP hovers show exact progress.

[*] A few world touches. Heat Wave is back, Croa now leave corpses if they can’t reach their nests, along with some other UI adjustments and Creative Mode fixes. 
[/list]
We set out to improve onboarding, performance, and quality of life—plus add options like Creative and new settings. The Capstone Update completes that plan, and we’re proud of where the game has landed. We’ll continue to keep an eye on feedback from new and returning players. As always, thank you for being part of our community, for the thoughtful feedback, and for helping shape Mind Over Magic! 


[b]With magic and love,

Sparkypants[/b]



[h3]Update Details[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Improvements to framerate stuttering related to stored items.
  [*]New alert icon that appears on doors that cannot be used because they are not on a Floor or Foundation.
  [*]Fixes for drag selection when clicking in front of a Support Column or Stair.
  [*]Fix for rare cases where Underschool Rooms end up with blocked pathing due to the order placing items.
  [*]New alerts that appear when Mages are At Death's Door and there are no Medical Beds or existing Medical Beds are not allowed to be used by the downed Mages.
  [*]Fix for situations where resources reserved for Construction or Assembly could be used for crafting.
  [*]Fix for the Spice Rack not appearing in Inventory.
  [*]If a Croa cannot reach its nest or the back of the land, it will die and leave behind a corpse instead of simply disappearing.
  [*]Heat Wave event now occurs again. It was disabled pre-1.0, but it is back now.
  [*]Improved detection of Private rooms in cases where stairs cut through corners. This will not impact existing saves.
  [*]Fix for Chopping the Jade Eggplant creating three Jade Dragon Eggs in Creative Mode.
  [*]Tutorial goals for building a Chest and crop Plots now appear and immediately complete if you have already built them. This makes it apparent that you completed a goal and prevents the goal from possibly appearing later in the game.
  [*]Added Public Room Keyword. This replaces "Must Not Be Private" as a condition on Room Types.
  [*]Fixes to the Magic Mirror so that customizations are not sometimes lost when hiring or apprenticing.
  [*]If a Dragon Egg Incubator is shrunk, it will now keep its Task for putting an egg inside when enlarged.
  [*]Fix for links to Job Types in selection action button hover text so that they look like links.
  [*]Fix for Ritual entries in the Codex that were showing invalid costs.
  [*]Updated Repel Fog and Hire rituals in the Codex to better describe them.
  [*]Potion selection UI no longer scales with the UI Scaling option so that it always fits on screen.
  [*]Enlarged all the text in the Codex.
  [*]Removed Wand Tier 4 as a possible selection in the Groups UI.
  [*]When hovering Skill XP bars, the hover text now shows the exact progress.
  [*]Updated text to help clarify that Broken furniture must be repaired before Disintegrating to recover all the resources.
  [*]Updated Fractal Mold description to help clarify that it can only be harvested at night.
  [*]Fix for search in the Codex not always finding entries by name.
  [*]Fix for combat icons sometimes showing up with incorrect icons or stack amounts.
  [*]Fix for hover text on the Relic slots on the Mage Sheet to show the Affinity information from the perspective of a mage, not a relic.
  [*]Update Tanning Rack description to not say it is required to build an Atelier.
  [*]Only show item dimension once when hovering on the Research UI.
  [*]The Dance Party ritual now counts toward the Dancing Queen Trial.
  [*]Eliminated some ways in which Rifts could appear in very small, unconnected spaces.
  [*]Improved the clarity of the Unreachable alert on a bed by making it show in the way whether the bed is assigned or just allowed for one Mage.
  [*]Added an icon to the Ritual selection button that shows when the Ritual is not allowed due to having an X Task Priority.
  [*]Showing at least a minimum cost for the Summon rituals rather than no cost when no wands are selected.
  [*]Fix for situations where two Mages/Helpers could get stuck with both trying to take the same item from storage.
  [*]Better handling of Staff sitting and libations AI when Staff outnumber available seating.
  [*]Fix Dormitory and Bedroom incorrectly counting Cots with Plain Beds.
  [*]Stop current task if Founder Relic is removed from attuned Mage who is not standing on solid ground.
  [*]Fix Cram Session achievement to account for time spent as a Student.
[/list]

notes.title: Headmaster's Guide to Survival
notes.content:
A common request we hear from new players is that they want a tutorial that provides more guidance. Now we have one!

Our goal was to make a system that reacts to your play, rather than force you to do exact steps before you can make your own choices. For example, if you start summoning students before that goal appears, you'll never see it. We tried to find a balance between delivering easily understood guidance and maintaining a feeling that you can do whatever you want, no matter what the goals say.

The tutorial is only active for new games and can be disabled in settings at any time. 

As always, we snuck in some QoL. There's now a School History button at the Book of Rituals where you can see every Mage that has left your school. We added plenty of other bug fixes and improvements as well, which you can see in the build notes below!

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
  [*]New tutorial system and UI!
  [*]New tabs at the basement book (now called School History) that shows all former students and staff, how they left, and what they looked like.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay and Balance[/h3]
[list]
  [*]The gruel pot is now a little faster to research.
  [*]Fixed skill cap allocation for new students so that all magic skills have an equal chance at being a secondary skill.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fixed a problem where the Build menu could get stuck closed by holding control and right-clicking while placing furniture.
  [*]Added a keybinding for showing the Codex (Y).
  [*]No longer show Ember Dragon in Sources lists since they show up for about everything. 
  [*]Updated the Sources order so that quilted are at the end.
  [*]Use 24h time in the two places we weren't (log display and hud clock mouseover)
  [*]Fix not being able to place furniture when using search while the Shrinks tab is selected.
  [*]On unreachable bed alert, show individuals who can't reach a bed for sleeping instead of the groups that are allowed. This prevents one blocked-off mage from triggering an alert that says 'all staff, all students' can't reach a bed.
  [*]Performance improvements for Mages putting lots of things in storage in complex schools.
  [*]Don't show Possible Break Risk unless Mage is in the Bad Mood Conviction zone (which is 7.5 hours before a break is possible).
  [*]Fix for count of incorrect rules when displaying room type checklist
  [*]Added the Loud Room keyword to help make the Silent keyword easier to understand.
  [*]Fix small arch support research being unlocked at game start.
  [*]Fix for debug trailer camera mode so that it can be properly closed.
  [*]School start screen uses proper faction icons now if you allow all factions.
  [*]Fix for popups at the start of game not processing properly if there are multiple.
  [*]Don't show dragon need alert when need can't be satisfied because a quest is active.
  [*]Fix for visuals on top of hallway block when stacked directly on top of other hallway block.
  [*]Make sure as students become apprentices and eventually staff, any allowed groups they were set that are now illegal get cleaned up.
  [*]Fix missing range calculation in ghost spellcasting so that ghosts no longer sometimes have infinite range.
  [*]Fix possible exception in rare case of spell targeting failing.
  [*]Fix for recreation need status being improperly shown on status page
  [*]Fixes for typos and language support throughout.
  [*]Fix a rare situation where a Mage thinks they can't reach a position to cast, but actually can.
  [*]Disable the Begin Ritual for Student Summoning if no wand is selected.
  [*]Don't show Captured creatures in the Resources/New lists until you have actually captured one.
  [*]When using the pathing filter with something selected that allows Assignments like a bed, show the pathing relative to the assigned Mage, not the selected object.
  [*]Fix new school UI to properly show shuffled keywords after editing in the Customize UI.
  [*]Fix for DoUntilX crafting for paintings/sculptures not showing the proper amounts.
  [*]When changing the difficulty level during gameplay, the Architecture Style (room keywords) no longer change automatically. You can still change the Architecture Style directly if you want to.
  [*]Fix for situation where battles that ended with a Mage taking lethal damage while using the Move action would soft lock. Schools stuck in this state will now exit combat when loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Creative Mode Update
notes.content:
One of the most common topics for feedback we receive is, "I want to be able to just build whatever!" That's what Creative Mode is all about. You don't need to research or worry about the Fog or resources in order to construct the perfect school and furnish it. For some, this will be a practice mode to try out different ideas for their next Relentless run. For others, this is is the mode they've been wanting to play in all the time. We're looking forward to see what you do with it!

There are also some frequently requested QoL and balance changes in this update, like shorter quest and construct times and the ability to queue up new Initiate Summons.

We've also heard from many players that combat can get repetitive when you're not playing on Relentless mode. We've now enabled Advanced Battle Strategy by default on Standard difficulty and show that as a top-level checkbox when creating a new game. This is not about making the game harder, but about letting the full depth of the combat systems show through in the standard game. Like other difficulty settings, you can disable it at any time to simplify things!

We have two more updates planned. The next one will add more guidance to the beginning of the game to help new players get started and explore ways to add more replayability to the game. After that, we'll be focused on QoL, especially for commonly requested UI and planning improvements.

We hope you enjoy the update. Thanks for playing Mind Over Magic!

notes.title: Hills + QoL Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's been really exciting to see the influx of new players and feedback since the 1.0 launch. We read everything and appreciate hearing all the compliments and critiques.

This is the first of multiple updates you can expect over the next few months. By popular demand, you can now play on a totally flat world or challenge yourself with more hills to deal with. There are numerous bug fixes, QoL improvements, and perf improvements in this update as well. Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming!

The next update will have improvements for new players and lots more QoL. More info as we get closer!

Build notes below...

notes.title: Endgame Update + 1.0 Launch
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FLdhqCBDRjI;full][/previewyoutube]

Class is in session! Mind Over Magic is now officially 1.0!

Since Early Access began we have worked to add a bunch of new content and features. Your great feedback helped us improve and refine the game in ways we never imagined. 

We've added to and deepened just about every aspect of the game. From student progression to Underschool exploration and better combat. Balance refinements, deeper gameplay, tons of quality-of-life improvements, and frankly just about more of everything.

For more information on the roadmap and everything we did during early access, you can start with our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/1270580/announcements/detail/4195747069378942128]Early Access Roadmap[/url] or check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1270580/allnews/]updates on Steam[/url]. 

Thanks once again to all of the enthusiastic players who helped shape Mind Over Magic.

Our update today brings the ending encounter in the Underschool.  Are your students ready to break the curse?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474644/bcb9de93f0578750410bd0d30e72dbf477b6391e.png[/img]

[h3]Update Highlights[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Break the curse on your school in the final Underschool battle.
  [*] Trade with the Ember Dragon and embark on new quests.
  [*] Dig into The Codex and learn about everything in the game.
  [*] 82 Achievements to earn!
[/list]

Next up, we’ll spend a little bit of time addressing feedback from this update and release hotfixes for any of the issues that we find. We’re also working on an additional QoL update featuring many of the great suggestions from our player community!

We’ll release more information about our upcoming plans as soon as it’s ready! 

Full release notes below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474644/f32a410225c96fb94ca46f6ff260275cbeb83582.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270580/Mind_Over_Magic/

[h2]Endgame + 1.0 Update Release Notes[/h2]

[h3]Break the Curse[/h3]
[list]
  [*]The Nexus gets even deeper and more dangerous.
  [*]Fight past what guards the source of the Curse, find a way through the seals, and end it forever!
[/list]
[h3]The Ember Dragon[/h3]
[list]
  [*]You can now rescue the Ember Dragon in the Underschool.
  [*]New Faction Quests for the Shattered and Raven Cultists.
  [*]The Ember Dragon will now accept your Mystic Motes in trade for reagents.
  [*]They will also happily disintegrate unwanted reagents into Motes for you.
[/list]
[h3]The Codex + Tooltip Changes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Nearly everything in the game is now described in the Codex.
  [*]Tutorials have been updated with many new entries and others broken up into more digestible pieces. These are all now part of the Codex.
  [*]Tooltips that link to other information now work in a new way. After hovering for a brief moment, tooltips freeze in place so that you can hover links within them. This allowed us to solve "wall of tooltip" problems and make a lot of text much shorter.
[/list]
[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
[list]
  [*]82 Achievements to show off your completionist and challenge crushing accomplishments.
[/list]
[h3]Population Cap[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Instead of continuing to use ramping costs and times for summoning and hiring that somewhat hide what you can actually do in the game, we added a new mechanic.
  [*]There is now a hard cap of 3 Staff of each Wand Skill to start the game.
  [*]There is also now a global hard cap on all Mages. The global cap is the sum of all Skill caps.
  [*]You can increase the cap in each Skill by leveling up Skill Affinity Relics and putting them on display.
  [*]The maximum Mage pop cap is 6 in each Skill.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
  [*]You can now graduate multiple mages at once. IMPORTANT   [*]This only works on newly built Ritual Sigils because we needed to reserve more space for the extra participants.
  [*]You can now upgrade the Wands of multiple Mages at once at the Wand Transfigurators.
  [*]Show the relic level on relic level-up alerts.
  [*]Performance improvements to the Relics UI.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay and Balance[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Corrupted Mana Lanterns now come in three variants that affect different Wand Tiers and have different Resistances in battle.
  [*]The Burrower Spitter has arrived in the Underschool. It's a Boss Battle that was previously a random Battle. If you've already cleared this room, you can still fight the Burrower Spitter using the Rematch Effigy.
  [*]The Fog Aegis mechanics have been simplified for clarity. When filled with Dark Magic, one Fog Aegis will always repel the fog when it advances. It must be refilled in order to stop the Fog again the next night. It now takes longer to fill the Fog Aegis so that Dark Skill matters a little. (30 casts for Skill 1, 4 casts for Skill 8).
  [*]Made Breathstealer events trigger half as often.
  [*]Removed Founder Ghost from door access rules.
  [*]Fine Kitchen Cooking rate bonus increased from 200% to 300%.
  [*]Relic Legacy balance changes:
  [*]Invigorated now regens more mana per hour at all tiers, and also increases mana gained by Passing in combat.
  [*]Tinkerer also increases Paint speed.
  [*]Strongman also increases Carve speed.
  [*]The X-Wreathed legacies all apply to a much wider pool of tasks now, and the mood bonus at higher levels was increased by 5.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fix for auto-pause for quest completion not working.
  [*]Fixed Job Type descriptions for Alchemy and Augury to properly describe Abjuration and Scouting.
  [*]Can no longer place hallway runners floating in space.
  [*]Defaulting to Medium quality if gpu has less than 4 GiB of VRAM.
  [*]In combat, the action UI is now hidden if enemies take their turn first.
  [*]Fix for battle scouting not always showing the proper options.
[/list]

[h3]We've made many other fixes, balance, and QoL changes in this update. Cheers to everyone who entered the Nexus to test it in Beta/Prerelease.[/h3]

[h2]Up Next[/h2]
[h3]Endgame[/h3]
[list]
  [*]You can expect a new introduction to the game and improved help to learn the game. 
  [*]The Nexus will grow even further to reveal who or what created the curse afflicting the school.
  [*]Tons of bug fixes and QoL.
[/list] 

[h3]You may notice some deviations from the roadmap in this release. We'll post a roadmap update along with dev notes discussing our choices in the next few days. Have fun in the Nexus![/h3]

[h3]Full build notes below. Happy Holidays![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474644/fd02509142abf85440f02c1086bb21b83e6a8cf3.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Nexus[/h2]
[list]
  [*]New Underschool rooms to explore in the Nexus zone.
  [*]Infinite Hallways give endless rooms to battle for Mages of all Levels.
  [*]The Altar of Fate allows customization of Relic Slots, Relic Legacies, and Uncompleted Trials.
  [*]Nexus Gateways allow traveling directly to key points in the Underschool.
  [*]Three new enemies to battle.
  [*]The Nexus will grow even more in the Endgame update.  
[/list]

[h2]New Quests / Jade Dragon[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Complete quests in the Human and Vivified lands at the Jade Dragon. Mages can gain extra potion slots and immunity to pain!
  [*]Blooming, Hatching, and raising a Jade Dragon takes a little less grinding now. 
  [*]Blooming does not require planting any plants nearby, but now requires Apprentices. 
  [*]The baby and juvenile stages require 3 days instead of 4 to grow.
  [*]The Affection Need now fills in 2.5 hours of work instead of 6.
[/list]
[h2]Seasonal[/h2]
[list]
  [*]It's Holiday Season!
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Plots and Planters now have a Harvest (or Chop) Limit that can be set. When you have more than the limit of a Reagent, Mages will not Harvest that plot or planter.
  [*]Plots and Planters no longer display a Harvest icon when growing or waiting for Harvest. Instead they show a Disabled icon when harvest has been disabled by pressing Cancel Harvest. This was both a visual and performance improvement.
  [*]Mages should now much less frequently get stuck behind furnishings when Assembling.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay and Balance[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Dragon Wok recipes that require Crabbage, Meat, Jumping Nuts, or Rock Candy output two meals per cook instead of one.
  [*]Fine Kitchens now allow a Gruel Pot so that you do not need a lower tier kitchen as well.
  [*]Standard Difficulty will no longer get multiple Invasion, Breathstealer, or Bramblespawn events on the same day.
  [*]Slightly nerfed enemies in higher level parties that appear from Corrupted Mana Lanterns because they were a bit harder than intended.
  [*]Made the deepest Corrupted Mana Lanterns wait a little longer before appearing.
  [*]Attuning is now about 75% faster than before.
  [*]Staff can now use the Statue Carvery and Easel.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Adding text to Mage Needs regarding whether they pause/change during sleep.
  [*]Statues and paintings of founder ghost should look like the ghost looked at time of painting/sculpting, not like the original dead mage looked like.
  [*]Don't allow Shapeshifting setup when having a Break.
  [*]Turn off Idle changes being logged in the Logbook to avoid some spam.
  [*]AIs not controlled by the player (ie, croa) will ignore Never player priorities on entities/errands.
  [*]Changed "Enemy Level" text for battle start UI to say "Recommended Mage Level" to more accurately describe what that means.
  [*]Added a multiple effect icon for Job Type Priority buttons to handle the case where several effects are active and not just a Love or Hate.
  [*]Red feed alerts now all share the same sound to make it more clear when an important event is occurring.
  [*]Audio mix improvements across all sounds.
  [*]Founder ghost now properly changes faction when using the Magic Mirror.
  [*]Mages will now properly do Low Priority Tasks before filling Mana. If they are below 50% Mana and Idle, they will still fill Mana. Thanks, @Ugly.
  [*]Updated visuals for Crystal Prophecy and Crystal Portent.
  [*]Perf improvements related to shadows that help large schools.
  [*]Remove debug recipes that could appear on the Meals UI.
  [*]Fix the Quest UI sometimes overflowing.
  [*]Fix for Messy Meddlers missing their status icon in Advanced Combat.
  [*]Fix for hover text link explosion on Periodical Kiosk.
  [*]Fix for Wolfkin using some incorrect animations (Hunt, for example.)
  [*]Fix for Mana Lantern sometimes looking like it's empty, but still allowing a charge.
  [*]Fix for issue where sometimes Shrinks could not be stored after cancelling an Un-Shrink.
  [*]Fix Disable World Camera Shake not being saved between sessions.
  [*]Added linked text to Attuned, Painter, and Sculptor Trials to make it more clear where to accomplish them.
[/list]

    [*]The Staff Lounge is a new Room Type where Staff can sit and Recreate with a Libation.
    [*]Staff gain Conviction and Recreation from using the Staff Lounge.
    [*]Libations are crafted at the Libation Fountain using Spices.
    [*]Spices can be refined at the Midden Jelly, Lavalina Sty, Crone Bug, and Weaver Bird using Seeds.
    [*]Spices can also be crafted at the Gruel Pot using reagents other than Seeds.
[/list]

[h2]Paintings and Statues[/h2]
[list]
    [*]The Easel and Statue Carvery are now available earlier and their room types have fewer requirements.
    [*]If Paintings and Statues are crafted in their room types, you can select a the Mage you want to paint or carve.
    [*]The Luxury value of the art work now depends on the Skill of the creator.
    [*]New artworks now give Luxury types instead of Basic Luxury and higher Luxury value.
    [*]The type of Luxury depends on the Wand Skill and Apprentice Skill of the subject.
 [/list]

[h2]Alchemistry Lab and Decoction Apparatus[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Alchemy finally gets its very own room.
    [*]The Alchemistry Lab requires a Decoction Apparatus.
    [*]The Decoction Apparatus is used for advanced potions, including the Sal Oblivium reagent for Scouting and other top tier potions that have moved from the Alchemist's station.
    [*]Look for new potions in future updates.
 [/list]

[h2]Divinatorium[/h2]
[list]
[*] This new room that requires a Crystal Ball for Augury makes that job type much faster.
[/list]


[h2]Screenshot Mode[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Look for the button on the bottom center time control (or shift-c) and take your perfect shots!
[/list]

[h2]Conviction/Doubts Changes[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Doubts have been reworked in theme and in how they are applied.
    [*]They are now called Weight of Malice in preparation for more lore coming in the Nexus and Endgame Updates.
    [*]Base Conviction is now 25 instead of 60.
    [*]Weight of Malice statuses start off at +40 Conviction at the beginning of the game. Their Conviction boost decreases with MAGE score in smaller, linear chunks, as opposed to the larger jumps that Doubts had.
    [*]Understaffed Conviction penalties have been removed.
[/list]
  
[h2]QoL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Broom Rack access now separated into departures vs arrivals.
    [*]Broom Racks can be built using Copy with Settings.
    [*]Storage chests now allow access rules for deposits and withdrawals.
    [*]Separate out shrinks for paintings and sculptures in the build palette so you can hover and see the specific luxury.
[/list]
  
[h2]New Initiate/Apprentice Trials[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Obliterator: X kills in a single battle
    [*]Defender: Fight X Battles Above Ground
    [*]Ritual Participant: Attend N Rituals
    [*]Nurturer: X Tends
    [*]Warder: X Wards
    [*]Pain Avoider: No In Pain for X days
    [*]Insightful: Do double damage to an enemy via a Terrain effect or Weakness
    [*]Attuned: Attune N Relics
    [*]Hunter: Hunt X Captured Creatures (Apprentice Only)
    [*]Sculptor: Make X Statues (Apprentice Only)
    [*]Painter: Make X Paintings (Apprentice Only)
 [/list]

[h2]Re-balanced Student/Apprentice Trials[/h2]
[h3]Reduced the number of repetitions for:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Neatnik
    [*]Charger
    [*]Pyromania
    [*]Commons Designer
    [*]Commons Sleeper
[/list]
[h3]Changed to time-based instead of repetition based:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Creature Comforter
    [*]Dancing Queen
[/list]  
[h3]No longer granted:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Enemy Soloist
    [*]Rested Fighter
    [*]Full Fighter
[/list]

    [*]When assigning relics for display, if there is another of that type, display a warning.
    [*]Shrinks for paintings / sculptures displays the subject and lux of the art inside when selected.
    [*]Don't show 'not repairing' icon when damage hasn't reach auto-repair threshold.
    [*]Recreation description now includes the target's display name if appropriate.
    [*]For the Founder school Relics display, separate out the duplicate inactives that are equal or lower level to the same display effect.
    [*]Fix for Upwell not being target-able in combat setup for some boss fights.
    [*]Adjust ritual/combat setup camera for lower ratio resolutions to keep things on screen.
    [*]Don't show decimals for trial progress on small combat icons.
    [*]Fix painting/sculpture durability.
    [*]Back compat: Set all old statues to full durability.
    [*]Fix a rare issue with pathing for queued construction that could result in no path being found.
    [*]Fix giving food to knocked out Mage when there's only one meal available.
    [*]Lower relative Task Type Priority of Mana refilling so Mages will use more of their Mana when working low priority tasks.
    [*]Students hired as staff will start with All Staff group priorities if using advanced mode, but staff are set to ignore group priorities.
    [*]Changed 'Any' on Easel/Statue Carvery UI to be more clear: 'Any Mage' and 'Any Luxury Type'
    [*]Replaced 'On Underschool Run' with 'Heading to Battle' to cover above ground battle prep
    [*]Update Fog tendril visuals when a Gloom event starts or stops.
    [*]Improved Painting visuals.
    [*]Fix monsters not starting battle at proper hp in some cases.
    [*]Don't teleport hallway runners when hallway/door is built or destroyed. Hallway runner must be disassembled if wall will replace hallway/door.
    [*]Fixes for shrink visual effects being left on.
    [*]Fix Harvest alert positions when plants are teleported due to construction changes.

    [*]Show resist before weakness in statuses UI for combat.
    [*]Corrosion no longer damages mages with the Stoneskin effect

    [*]Fix battle start button sometimes not being clickable without a reload.
    [*]Fix Bramblespawn issue where Bramblespawn spore is sometimes not able to take root in targeted room.

notes.title: Ultimates Update: Balance, Improvements, and Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Ultimates Fixes - 11/19/24[/h2]
[list]
  [*] Fix for invisible Mages after leaving battle with Stoneskin.
  [*] Fix Burrower Larva battle if dark ultimate is cast on Burrower Larva spawns.
  [*] Fix for a crash when some firewalls deny access.
[/list]


[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 11/11/24[/h2]
  
[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Improved Pustulant Carcass attack visuals.
  [*] Fixes for un-translateable text.
  [*] Made the seasonal visuals setting visual, but disabled, while in game.
  [*] Visual improvements to the Dark, Earth, Lightning, Nature, and Water Ultimates.
  [*] Lightning strikes visually show that there are different damage levels.
  [*] Lightning strikes show where they will hit with sparkling FX before the strike actually hits.
  [*] Unique FX for when Lighting hits a Lightning Rod.
  [*] Audio improvements to Lightning Ultimate.
  [*] Fixes for some full-screen FX during events. e.g. Cold Snap, Heatwave, Gloom
  [*] Fix for poison visuals so that the FX last as long as they should, even if the target dies.
[/list]


[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 11/6/24[/h2]

[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fix for schools that had an unfinished construction block that was broken, and then cancelled.
  [*]Fix cast animation not playing when one mage needs to run multiple counter attack visualizations in a row.
  [*]Fix for error when dragging the queue and rightclicking simultaneously on the Research UI.
  [*]Fixed an error where the music would revert to main game play music from combat music after entering a ritual window.
  [*]Fix potential loss of input when entering combat while placing.
  [*]Adjust default camera field of view for lower ratio screens in combat to avoid overlaps.
  [*]Added ability to use custom resolutions.
  [*]Better adjusting Combat Log height based on screen ratio.
  [*]Combat Log now can scroll.
[/list]


[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 11/5/24[/h2]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fix for Mages sometimes gaining improper extra statuses for upgraded Wand needs. (Victory, etc.)
[/list]

[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 11/4/24[/h2]

[h3]Critical Fixes[/h3]
  [*]Fix for issues where sometimes Mages could not deliver everything needed.

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
  [*]Fixes for Doubt changes that happen when a Mage is on a broom.
  [*]Setting to enable and disable seasonal graphics while on the main menu. Forever halloween!
  [*]Updated Nature Ultimate audio.
  [*]Updated FX for Crystal Ball.
  [*]Updated Sal Reagents.
  [*]Fixes for Staff animations.
  [*]Fixes for Twitch client stability.


[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 11/3/24[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix error when dragging a crafting item and right-clicking.
[*] Tighter fit on the right side for rituals for a better fit and to avoid the Start Ritual button being off screen.
[*] Add scrolling for rewards on post-combat UI as needed.
[/list]
Also aware of some issues with deliveries before construction. A proper fix will probably be tomorrow (Monday).


[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 11/1/24[/h2]

[h3]Critical Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fix for some more older saves (pre-Apprentice release) that would load properly, then crash when hiring Students. Apologies to @HLLT and others!
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]In advanced combat, Hallowed One and Torch Snuffer now only drain mana on hits.
  [*]The founder will now sometimes cast while floating inside of blocked areas if it's the only way to reach their target.
  [*]Changes to ensure that adjusting low priority Storage will trigger evaluating Tasks on higher priority storage also.
[/list]

[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 10/31/24 (Boo!)[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Corrupted Mana Lanterns will now appear in the wings closest to the surface before pushing deeper.
  [*]Sustaining Terrain now works for enemies.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Improvements to Torrent spell targeting.
  [*]Show info to explain that you need a meal when both in a starving state and At Death's Door in the alert message and hover.
  [*]Removed Augury Job Type from students who gained it due to a bug.
  [*]Fix incorrect and extra statuses showing up for battle setup related to boon/wane events.
  [*]Improved simulation performance when looking at the Tasks UI with many tasks.
  [*]Improved Ultimate animations.
  [*]Fixes for audio stinger balance and other audio issues.
  [*]Fix issue where haulers were frozen due to an out-of-date 'move from storage to storage' task.
  [*]Improvements to the Ritual UI to not overflow when there are many attendees. Especially helps in some non-English translations.
  [*]Updated Counterattack description to clarify which spell it will use and that it costs Mana.
[/list]

[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 10/30/24[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Standard Difficulty starts with 3 Mages instead of 2.
[*]Added new difficulty setting to allow healing slowly while sleeping in a regular bed.
[*]Relaxed difficulty now lets Mages heal slowly while sleeping in a regular bed.
[*]Added new difficulty setting for Advanced Wand Needs to select between an easier and harder mode.
[*]Relaxed difficulty now uses an easier version of the Advanced Wand Needs.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fix for issue where hired students could end up with an extra Scar.
[*]Make sure 'move between storage' tasks are updated properly if low priority storage gets a higher priority.
[*]Fix issue where haulers would lock-up when considering tasks to move objects from one storage to another.
[*]On the in-world UI for starting a battle, show the reason for battle not starting like we do for the alert hover.
[*]Fix duplicate apprentice status showing up in combat setup.
[*]Fix for incorrect wand need parameters if you changed difficulty during the game.
[*]Unknown Scar Effects are now properly labeled that instead of Unknown Quirk.
[*]Adjusted Book of Rooms to fit 4:3 screens.
[*]Improved audio for Dark Ultimate.
[/list]

[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 10/29/24[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Mages will no longer go start battles if they do not have their requested Potion.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Added alerts for Battles and Rituals not starting due to lack of resources or unreachable resources.
  [*]Performance improvements for schools with many haulers, but not much storage available.
  [*]Dark Ultimate can now be targeted on enemies.
  [*]Added a Feed Alert for Spectral Croa appearance.
  [*]Added more information to explain that Spectral Croa can appear from Croa Corpses in storage on Spectral Croa description.
  [*]Improved Fire, Dark, and Water Ultimate visuals.
  [*]Added more information on Research UI and an Alert to show when the Research is not possible because the tier requirements(Skill/Room) are not met.
  [*]Fix for allied statuses not being detected properly for some spell cost modifiers, e.g. With Shadow Cloak, Tentacle Sweep II cost was not being reduced.
  [*]Early Rain events without lightning strikes are now just called Rain and not Storms in their alerts.
  [*]Rampage no longer targets furniture in fog or in Invaded rooms.
  [*]Now showing battle-related statuses in Combat Setup, like those from Bane events.
  [*]Now showing Blood Magic (Raven Cult Bane) costs in the Combat UI.
  [*]Updated Flow II and Flow III descriptions to have all the information that Flow I does.
  [*]Fix for Mana being over Mana Max when losing Dauntless from high Conviction.
  [*]Fix for L8-L10 Ember Golem text to correctly link Counterattack instead of Retaliate.
  [*]Now linking Blood Magic in Combat Log when it applies damage to Mages.
  [*]Fix for main menu music sometimes not fading our properly when loading a save while in combat.
  [*]Fixes for Crystal Ball icon.
  [*]Tweaked the Book of Rooms to make it more clear that you can scroll to see more.
[/list]



[h2]Ultimates Balance and Fixes - 10/28[/h2]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Relaxed mode has starting research again. Applies to new games and existing saves from Ultimates.
  [*]Slightly nerfed enemy parties with Scythes in them. They now have advantaged terrain for the player, worse terrain for enemies, and weaker or fewer sidekicks for the Scythes.
  [*]Adjusted pacing of early-game events so that they don't hit quite as early.
  [*]Relaxed difficulty enemies how have lower HP.
  [*]Added more low Enemy HP custom difficulty options.
  [*]Tentacle Sweep HP cost lowered from 25% of Max HP to 20% of Max HP.
  [*]Introversion/Extroversion Needs no longer consider Quilted Helpers.
  [*]Doubled Victory gain from doing combat damage and killing enemies.
  [*]2.5x Victory gain from winning a battle.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fixes for Founder Ghost sometimes getting stuck doing deliveries.
  [*]Updating Chinese translation with fixes.
  [*]Improvements to Room Requirements display.
  [*]Fix for enemy UI in combat being visible when it shouldn't be.
  [*]Fix for several descriptions not being updated properly for Ultimates.
  [*]Fix for a combat soft-lock when knocked out by exiting a lava terrain.
  [*]Fixed bug where dragon incubator tend window would spam UI sound
  [*]Fix deliveries by mages who don't have any skill in air. Among other issues, this could cause failure to perform rituals.
  [*]Fix for situations where Room Types might not be applied after a change to doors or halways.
  [*]Fix for some old savegames(pre-April) being loaded improperly and then crashing when hiring a staff. Reload your original save to fix if you have this situation.
  [*]Fix for Detachment 2 hover text.
  [*]Fix status icons not showing up in some cases during combat on the side displays.
  [*]Gaining Dauntless from high Conviction will now preserve the current mana fill %.
[/list]

notes.title: Ultimates Build and Dev Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Dev Notes[/h1]

We’ve received feedback that you’d like to continue receiving full change notes with the Steam updates, so those are below! We also wanted to say a little about our intent with some of these changes.

Our goal is to make MoM the best game it can be and to use Early Access to its fullest. That means change, and sometimes aggressive change. With the Ultimates update, we are aiming to deliver interesting combat systems with a variety of strategic options and some subtlety that takes time to master. That has meant shaking up the combat meta. Based on feedback so far, we’re much closer to having every Magic Skill be powerful in the right moment, but we will keep monitoring all the posts on Steam, Discord, and Reddit and make adjustments as necessary.

The Difficulty changes we’ve made streamline the way you start a new game. Instead of making multiple choices about difficulty, you now just choose between three levels. Based on feedback, we realized that players were sometimes choosing a middle level that was harder or easier than they thought they would get, so we simplified the process while keeping the ability to completely customize the experience. 

Standard difficulty should now represent what we expect from MOM. It has interesting choices with consequences, both positive and negative. It may be harder than some players expect based on their past experience with the game. Relaxed difficulty is intended to be the mode where you can always recover from problems and you can play at your own pace. We’ve gotten a lot of useful feedback on difficulty already and are making some adjustments, especially for Relaxed and Standard modes.

If the game is too hard, keep in mind that you can change your difficulty level at any time during the game and even customize exactly which aspects are harder and easier from the settings menu. 

Looking forward, this is likely the last time we’ll really shake up core game play so deeply. On our path to a 1.0 release, we’ll be adding to and enriching the Underschool, extending the lore of the game, adding new quests, and endgame goals. As always, we’ll continually mix in QoL and other improvements. Thanks for all the play, feedback, and help as we strive to make MOM into the game we’d all like to play.


[h1]Combat[/h1]

[h2]Level 8 Spells[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Mages at Skill 8 now get access to Ultimate spells. These are ultra powerful, expensive spells to turn the tide of even the hardest battles.
  [*]Ultimates can only be cast a limited number of times per day. Each Mage intrinsically has one Ultimate Cast every 24 hours; even if they have two Ultimates, they will only be able to cast one each day.
  [*]Mages with high Conviction will have +1 Ultimate Cast per day.
  [*]Mages that Apprentice in the same Skill as their Wand (aka Mancers) will gain +1 Ultimate Cast per day. (See Apprentice Specializations section below.)
  [*]All Ultimates cost 150 mana to cast. Mages who have a D grade or better in Mana will be able to afford to cast at least one Ultimate by level 18.
[/list]
[h2]The Ultimates[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Tornado Trap (Air): Attacks an enemy five times. Adds Shield 3 to the caster.
  [*]Lance (Fire): Deals heavy damage to a front row enemy. Has a 50% chance to crit, and pierces all shields, armor, and resistance effects. Any overkill damage is dealt to the enemy behind the target.
  [*]Tsunami (Water): Damages all enemies. Each ally is healed for 25% of the total damage dealt.
  [*]Polarize (Lightning): Summons a Thundercloud over a targeted enemy. The Thundercloud strikes the target, then a random enemy, then repeats that pattern for up to 8 total hits. Each time an enemy dies, an ally regains 75 mana. 50% Power and 50% Speed contributes to damage.
  [*]Stoneskin (Earth): Adds Taunt 4 to the caster, and the caster is Damage Immune until the end of the next round.
  [*]Waves of Death (Dark): Attacks the front-most row of enemies 3 times. Any enemies killed leave behind a Pustulant Carcass after the Waves finish. The carcass explodes for 40 damage at the end of the round, or immediately after being hit.
  [*]Wither (Nature): Inflicts the Wither debuff on all enemies. Wither deals 30 damage at the end of the round, then the damage increases by 30. Whenever an enemy afflicted by Wither dies, the most hurt ally is healed for the Wither amount.
[/list]
[h2]Potion Changes[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Mages can no longer access a communal pool of Potions. Instead, Potions function more like Relics; they are equipped from the Mage Sheet, and each individual Mage will only be able to use their own equipped Potions.
  [*]Mages will automatically refill their Potion slot with available Potions.
  [*]Currently all Mages have one Potion slot.
[/list]
[h2]Combat Terrain[/h2]
[list]
 Terrain has been added to combat. Different combat slots on either side of the battle can potentially have Terrain that affect combat in various ways. Different biomes will have different Terrain showing up.
[/list]

[i]Generic terrain (Can occur anywhere, including in The Spine)[/i]
[list]
  [*]Cover: Occupants dodge AOE attacks and debuffs   [*]only attacks and debuffs that specifically target the Cover Terrain affect occupants. Occupants take 100% extra damage from Earth attacks (except AOE Earth attacks), and then Cover goes away.
  [*]Mana Vein: Spells cast from Mana Vein terrain cost 50% less Mana. Only occurs on the Mages’ side of the battle.
[/list]
[i]Stone Ruins terrain[/i]
[list]
  [*]Shadow Cloak: Permanently Shadow Cloaked, granting 3a3% dodge chance.
  [*]Cleansing: Occupants can’t gain any status effects, positive or negative. Occupants take 100% extra damage from Dark attacks, but then Sanctified goes away.
  [*]Conductive: Occupants' Lightning attacks do 2x damage. Occupants take 100% extra damage from Lightning attacks, but then Conductive goes away.
[/list]
[i]Fungal Cavern terrain[/i]
[list]
  [*]Thorns: Permanent Thorns. Occupants take 10% of their Max HP as damage upon moving into or ending their turn in Thorns.
  [*]Entangling: Occupants cannot move or be moved out of Entangling Terrain, including by forced movement spells. Occupants also cannot be Hasted. Occupants take 100% extra damage from Fire attacks, but then Entangling goes away.
  [*]Sustaining: Occupants at >1HP survive any fatal attacks at 1HP. Occupants take 100% extra damage from Nature attacks, but then Sustaining goes away (occupant will survive the Nature attack at 1HP).
[/list]

[list]
  [*]Lava: Occupants take 20% of their Max HP as damage upon moving into or ending their turn in Lava. (a stronger version of Thorns). Occupants take 100% extra damage from Water attacks, but then the Lava goes away.
  [*]Gravel: Occupants are Slowed (act at the end of each round regardless of speed   [*]multiple Slowed characters act in Speed order). Occupants cannot be Hasted. Occupants take 100% extra damage from Air attacks, but then the Gravel goes away.
[/list]

[h2]Apprentice Specializations[/h2]
Depending on which Skill on the Apprentice Wheel a Mage becomes an Apprentice in, they will gain specific powers.

[h3]Mancers[/h3]
Mages who Apprentice in the same Skill as their Wand will become a Mancer (Pyromancer, Necromancer, etc.). They will get +1 daily use of their Ultimate Spell.

[h3]Conjurers[/h3]
Mages who Apprentice in an adjacent Skill to their Wand will become a Conjurer. They will gain more Skill Cap than usual, and not have any lowered Skill caps. (This is unchanged from release, but now has a name.)

[h3]Arcanists[/h3]
  [*]Mages who Apprentice in a Skill two away from their Wand will become an Arcanist. They will gain a Relic Slot of their Apprentice Skill. If they already have a Relic Slot of that Skill, they will gain a rare Relic Slot instead. This can result in a mage with up to 5 Relic Slots if the Mage is also Gifted.

[h3]Sorcerers[/h3]
Mages who Apprentice in a Skill three away from their Wand will become a Sorcerer. They will gain a special combat passive ability. Each combination has a different combat passive, intended to help create new and exciting combat builds.
[list]
  [*]Earth / Water: Whenever the Mage casts an Attack spell, they gain Armor equal to the Mana spent.
  [*]Earth / Air: When below 50% HP, the character deals 33% more damage.
  [*]Nature / Lightning: When the Mage receives a Buff from a spell or potion, a random Mage that does not have the Buff also receives it.
  [*]Nature / Air: All duration-based effects this Mage creates last for an additional combat round.
  [*]Fire / Dark: Has +25% Dodge. Regains HP equal to 10% of their maximum whenever they kill an enemy.
  [*]Fire / Water: Torrent and Flow gain 50% Critical Hit chance, and Critical Hits deal triple damage.
  [*]Dark / Lightning: Whenever this Mage casts a non-Attack spell, a random enemy becomes Doomed, causing them to take 1.5x damage from the next Attack spell that hits them.
[/list]

You can now change the battlefield before fighting battles.
Before each battle, you can select from two options for modifying terrain and enemies.
Scouting requires spending Crystallized Visions, and allows you to modify combat terrain to your advantage.
Crystallized Visions are new reagents that can be crafted at a new Crystal Ball crafting station via Augury, a new Lightning errand.
Abjuration requires spending reagents including Alchemical Salts, and allows you to modify enemy Weaknesses and Resistances to your advantage.
Alchemical Salts are new reagents that can be crafted at the Alchemist’s Station via Alchemy.

If they already have a Relic Slot of that Skill, they will gain a rare Relic Slot instead. This can result in a mage with up to 5 Relic Slots if the Mage is also Gifted.

Mages who Apprentice in a Skill three away from their Wand will become a Sorcerer. They will gain a special combat passive ability. Each combination has a different combat passive, intended to help create new and exciting combat builds.

notes.title: The Ultimates Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Ultimates Update[/h1]

The Ultimates Update brings more strategic depth to  Mind Over Magic combat, adding new ways to power up your Mages, and adding tough new challenges on higher difficulty levels.

There are also tons of QoL features and improvements to balance throughout the game. Highlights of all the changes can be found below.

Huge thanks to everyone who did advance playtesting on this update! We couldn’t do it without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474644/84be5d8ffaa86a13b97d479e59ddb81ebaa799e0.png[/img]

[h2]New Combat Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ultimate spells for every Magic Skill. They’re so powerful that they can only be cast once a day.
[*] Terrain in combat that creates positional tactics.
[*] Weaknesses and Resistances for enemies, adding a new strategic layer.
[*] Scouting and Abjuration, new abilities which allow players to transform battles before you fight them.
[*] A full rebalance of combat spells and Relic combat powers.
[/list]

[h2]Combat Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Potions are now equipped by Mages. Each Mage can carry 1 potion into battle.
[*] On the highest difficulty level, enemies scale up in HP and Damage less, but gain new combat abilities.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474644/d2109d93ff0742f730c5e74fb8703c5320b27b31.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay and Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] An overhaul of our difficulty modes, presenting players with three options that line up with the most common ways to play.
[*] Apprentices gain a new title (e.g. Conjurer, Arcanist) based on the Skill Wheel position of their Wand and Apprentice Skills. This grants them new upgrades.
[*] Research is now divided into tiers. Each tier requires a higher level of Lightning Skill and a better Research Room to work on Research in that tier.
[*] New events that impact larger schools at higher difficulty levels, including getting multiple Fog Incarnates, Breathstealers, or Bramblespawn at the same time.
[*] Mages now gain bonuses when they have high Conviction.
[*] Instead of positive and negative Quirks, Mages now gain a new Need when they upgrade their wand.
[*] Lightning storms have changed to be less punishing in the early game. Lightning rods and other roof decor are now more effective at blocking the more more powerful storms later, but require Repair.
[*] New Basic Architecture Style, requiring fewer keywords for Rooms for a simpler school building experience.
[/list]

There’s so much more, too! The complete set of changes is listed in-game and on Discord. As always, your old save games are valid to keep on playing with.

[h2]Up Next[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Magic Mirror - This release will let you do more Mage customization, will add new Mage visuals, and will have new Recreation options.
[*] The Nexus - The Underschool will expand!
[/list]

notes.title: The Jade Dragon
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]

The Jade Dragon update adds to the mid-game of Mind Over Magic and starts setting the stage for the late-game features still to come. As always, we've dropped in a healthy does of QoL that you will see in brand new games as well.

Hatching and raising a Jade Dragon is itself a major project with many steps. It will take time, preparation, many Mages, and new rooms to integrate the Jade Dragon into your school. 

Once you do, however, you'll unlock quests for your Mages. These quests involve selecting Mages with specific qualifications to send away from the school for a time. Doing so will upgrade your Mages and Relics in ways that cannot be done outside of quests. They also provide plenty of XP for high-level mages and even unique Relics.

These Quests also introduce the world of the Wolfkin outside of your school. Future releases will add quests that reveal more about other factions and mysteries.

Existing saves are compatible with this release. If you want to quickly check out a Jade Dragon, we recommend not starting over. We also kept a backup of your last save, so you can go back to it if you need to.

If you are looking to get a Jade Dragon as quickly as possible, simply push out your fog far enough (until you see the forest area) and you'll get an alert telling you how to get started. No more spoilers than that, though!

Many, many thanks to the Closed Beta and Pre-Release players for all their feedback. These players were critical in shaping how quests and the Jade Dragon work together.

Details below!

  [h1]Jade Dragon[/h1]
  [list]
  [*]To raise a Jade Dragon, find a Jade Eggplant near the edge of the forest zone(possibly under the Fog) to start the difficult process of hatching and growing the Dragon.
  [*]If you want to hurry to get a Jade Dragon, we do not recommend starting a fresh save. This is a mid-to-late-game feature that requires many aspects of a well developed school.
  [*]The Jade Dragon lets you send your Mages on Quests to learn what is happening outside of the School and gain unique powers.
  [*]New Dance Party Ritual at the Enchantophone.
  [*]New Group Project Ritual at the Chalkboard.
  [*]New Feast Ritual at the Dining Table.
  [*]New Bramblespawn event. A malicious spore grows in a room, eventually taking it over.
  [*]New Gloom event makes Fog advance faster at night.
  [*]Trapdoor vines can now Bind Croa.
  [*]Trapdoor vines can now kill Mages and Croa that have been Bound.
  [*]Updated Luxury System: Furnishings now can have different categories of Luxury.
  [*]Most Rooms with Luxury requirements now require a Luxury category instead of specific furnishings.
  [*]New Open Back Room Keyword disallows placement on the back wall of a Room. Used for Dragon Aerie.
  [/list]
  
  [h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
  [list]
  [*]Organization improvements for the Build Palette: sub-categories, alphabetization, showing a scroll bar when scrolling possible.
  [*]Right-click orders can now interrupt non-right-click orders that are currently using resources needed for the right-click order.
  [*]Players can now right-click 'pause until' errands (crafting and fill trough) to force them to start even when in the 'paused' state.
  [*]The Room Filter now allows you to select rooms. Room Goals and wallpaper selection are now part of the selected Room UI.
  [*]Fill, Charge, Tend, and Ward Tasks now all have a slider to adjust what fill level those Tasks will be performed at.
  [*]Ability to toggle a Planter/Plot's Harvest Task before the plant is planted.
  [*]Can now right-click order Beast Care errands before they would happen on their own.
  [*]Updated Heart icons for Job Type Priority and Meals UIs.
  [/list]
  
  [h1]Gameplay[/h1]
  [list]
  [*]Fog Incarnation now starts with Hunt enabled.
  [*]Croa now eat plants more slowly and it's easier to see when it is happening.
  [*]Scarecroa can now scare 20 times per charge.
  [*]When Mages Manifest a Relic, the Relic is always one that that matches the Affinity of one of their Relic slots.
  [*]New Likes and Dislikes for Light types in rooms.
  [*]New Likes for Luxury Categories in Rooms.
  [*]Greenhouse uses Open Back Room Keyword for new games only.
  [/list]
  
  [h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
  [list]
  [*]Fixed click detection on some rugs.
  [*]Updated Skewed Room Keyword description to explain how Skewed does not require a Roof to be active.
  [*]Fixed the algorithm that increased the chance of filth being created by high Skill Mages. Should be less Filth or a similar amount to before.
  [*]Fix for hovers on Stat Icons on Mage Sheet.
  [*]Fix for hovers and improved tooltips for Stat Grades on Mage Sheet.
  [*]Fixed Lightning Skill text typo.
  [*]Fixes for handling clicks on Captive Animals vs Wild in the Resources UI.
  [*]Improve Demolish tool UI by showing more clearly when it is unable to Demolish do to the filter selection on the tool, rather than a bug.
  [*]Fixes for the Groups UI to stay on screen when changing UI scale.
  [*]Fixes to hide Ribbon Button and Filter UIs when the combat setup screen appears.
  [*]Fix for windows closing when mouse is down (like on a scroll) and you release the mouse button over the world.
  [*]Fix for situations where Mages could try to deliver materials to construction blocks in the Fog.
  [*]Fix for Ooze Corpse and Gremlin Corpse showing up as possible stored items since they don't exist in the game.
  [*]Fix for ritual and combat setup screens at lower resolutions.
  [*]Improved Hunger Alert clarity.
  [/list]

notes.title: Ranching
notes.content:
Since we entered Early Access, one of the most requested features has been a way to automate Hunting. Now you can!

The process starts by building Pastures. From there, you build Rat's Nests and Croa Coops, then populate them with Captured Dire Rats and Croa. Your animals will breed new animals and you can specify how many animals you wish to be Automatically hunted. 

We also included balance changes, quality of life improvements, and some bug fixes, particularly for Relics.

This is our first release that hits bullets on our roadmap! We continue to work on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1270580/view/4195747069378942127?l=english]rest of the development roadmap[/url] as well. Thanks so much for all the support and feedback. 

[h1]Update Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Ranching[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dire Rats and Croa can now be Captured by Mages with Air Skill 1 and kept in Pastures.
[*] Research the necessary items on the Sizzling Flames section of the Research tree.
[*] To create a Pasture, you first create the land area with Pasture Construction Blocks. Then you build Rat's Nests and Croa Coops to hold animals and Feed Troughs to feed them.
[*] Captive Baby animals must be fed in order to grow.
[*] Captive Adult animals must be fed in order to create new babies.  
[*] Pairs of animals in Pastures spawn baby animals periodically. Baby animals grow up into adults over time.
[*] Adult animals are automatically marked for Hunt, but you can set how many Adults should be preserved so that breeding still occurs.
[*] Hunted Captive animals drop 2x the reagents of animals in the wild.
[/list]
[h2]Founder Casting Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Founder can now cast spells while floating in the air.
[*] This means that the Founder can now construct those hard to reach blocks that required temporary stairs in the past.
[*] The Founder no longer disappears if the Founder's Grave is broken, shrunk, or covered by Fog.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Swapped Elevated and Interior on Lair of Dark Arts and Windy Pinnacle. Only affects new Balanced games. Saved games on Balanced will still have the original keywords.
[*] Gnosis Shards from Gnosis Veins and Battle Crystals increased to match the increased Gnosis Shard costs in the prior release.
[*] Changed how many Gnosis Shards are gained from Pulverizing Relics from 2x Relic Level to Relic Level ^ 1.7. This makes Relics higher than Level 4 give substantially more.
[*] Scarecroa take Eyeball instead of Meat to build. Moving Scarecroa/Snaptrap/Pathstone tech to off Second Sight (Eyeball recipe) on tech tree.
[*] Sleeping in a Medical Bed now uses water power for faster healing.
[*] Croa without a Nest will now run into the trees and disappear.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mage Portrait UI at the top of the screen has been overhauled to take up less space and expand more gracefully as you gain more Mages.
[*] Architecture Style can now be changed during games. If you switch between Shuffled styles, they do not re-roll.
[*] Recipe tooltips now show where the Recipe can be used.
[*] Added Skill Requirement number to alerts and action buttons when an errand requires a Magic Skill higher than 1. (Runewood Chop, etc.)
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Relics show up as Inventory instead of Resources in the UI.
[*] Fix for cases where Relics could become unusable during Summoning.
[*] Fix Relics not being De-Attunable if above the Mage's current level.
[*] Warning message on Relic UI to say why a selected displayed Relic cannot be used for Summoning.
[*] Text updates for clarity on Faction Relic Display Powers.
[*] Foundation blocks now snap to terrain more easily when placing them.
[*] Fix Room Type Goal layout not always fitting the text properly.
[*] No longer clearing Room Type Goals when they are completed.
[*] Book of Rooms now shows Room Type Keywords in a different color than other text.
[*] Reduced audio spam from Gremlin Farms.
[*] Fix cycle tab hotkey not working and added cycle tab reverse to hotkey settings.
[*] Fix for Mages sometimes looking like they have multiple wands.
[*] When an Initiate becomes an Apprentice, any invalid assignments are released. This fixes Apprentices staying in an Initiate-only bed.
[*] When a Student is hired as Staff, any newly invalid assignments are released.
[*] When a Student is hired as Staff, the Staff member will preserve their Groups, Restrictions, and Job Type Priorities.
[*] Fix for auto-add on Staff for Advanced Task Type Priorities and Meals not working properly.
[*] Fixes for Relic window on narrow screens.  
[*] Fix for De-Attune button sometimes being placed off-screen.
[*] Fix possible screech sound on furniture Assemble.
[*] Changes to icon rendering to improve readability in UI.
[*] Polished Progress text on selection text for gather errands.
[*] Fix for typo in hover for Demolish.
[/list]
[h2]Twitch Integration[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added option to reset bits to zero when a name is used.
[*] Added options for requeuing behavior once a named character leaves the school.
[*] The Delete option will remove the name from the queue entirely upon the character leaving.
[*] The Balanced option will requeue the name but sort it lower to ensure that the same names don't keep showing up.
[/list]

[/list]

[h2]Potential Hardware / Driver Issues[/h2]
We've seen reports from some players where they are crashing to desktop somewhat regularly. For the ones we've been able to investigate, these crashes occur in dozens of different places within the core Unity engine.

We will continue investigations where we can but here are few things to consider:

[h3]Driver Updates[/h3]
We hate to go to this and sometimes we can work around driver bugs but having up-to-date drivers can make the difference, particularly for newer cards.

[h3]Intel Voltage issues[/h3]
Intel has noted some voltage issues with their 13th/14th gen CPUs. Here is a relevant article with some information: [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/hardware/processors/intel-finally-breaks-silence-points-finger-at-microcode-algorithm-voltage-errors-and-says-its-going-to-patch-core-13th14th-gen-cpu-stability-issues-mid-august/]PC Game Report[/url]. It appears that will likely be a patch available in mid-August so you might stay on the lookout for that.

That said we've also seen players with AMD chipsets who are experiencing instabilities which range widely. 

One thing you can try is adjusting the Worker Thread Count. We've added this option in Settings under Misc where you'll also find some additional information. 

Thanks for the reports and feedback!

notes.title: The Archive
notes.content:
This update brings The Archive and The Library, both new rooms that bring new power for relics. 

You can now level up relics by Attuning them to Mages and gaining XP. The Library is a room dedicated to Attunement that makes it go faster and lets Mages Attune Relics of a higher level than they are.

You can then put a Relic on display in the Archive to gain powers that affect the whole school. The higher level a Relic is, the stronger the power will be.

Architecture Styles are a new way to shake up your next run by changing the Room Keyword requirements of each Room Type. Each style emphasizes a different way of building and each can be a shuffled for even more variety. There is a new Room Filter UI and a Book of Rooms with new tools to help you build.

There are also a stack of balance changes, fixes, and quality of life improvements.

We continue to make progress on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1270580/view/4195747069378942127?l=english]development roadmap[/url] as well. Thanks so much for all the support and feedback. 

[h1]Update Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Relic Plinth Powers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Relics may now be Displayed on a Relic Plinth in an Archive Room to gain new Relic Plinth Powers, such as the ability to Summon Initiates of a specific Faction.
[/list]
[h2]Relic Level-Up and Drops[/h2]
[list]
[*] Relics now level up to gain power. Relics gain Relic XP while Attuned to a Mage and the Mage gains XP.
[*] Mages can now un-Attune a Relic any time in order to drop the relic.
[*] Relics can reach Level 24 and many have new or updated powers.
[*] In addition to Graduation and Retirement, new Level 1 Relics are now Manifested by Promotion to Apprentice and Hiring. Some Crystal Battles and Bosses now drop higher level Relics.
[*] When Mages Graduate, Retire, are Expelled, are Dismissed, or Die, their currently Attuned Relics now drop on the ground instead of disappearing.
[*] 15 new Relic models.
[/list]
[h2]Relic Attuning[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Library and Atheneum Rooms allow Mages to Attune Relics much faster and at levels higher than their own.
[*] Relics now take somewhat longer to Attune.
[/list]
[h2]Architecture Styles[/h2]
[list]
[*] When starting a new school, you can now choose from different Architecture Styles that impact which Keywords are required for Rooms.
[*] The Architecture Styles are Balanced, Wonky, Airy, Lofty, and Chaotic.
[*] Each Architecture Style may be Shuffled (besides Chaotic, which is already randomized) to make it more unique for new games without changing its theme.
[*] Existing games continue to use their current Keyword settings.
[*] On new games, the Towered keyword now requires an outdoor gap instead of a double-wall. 
[*] Existing games use the Towered (Legacy) keyword which still allows double-walls to satisfy the requirement.
[*] Three new keywords have been added to various rooms.
[*] Interior is a new keyword that requires a Room to not be adjacent to outdoors.
[*] Quiet is a new keyword that requires a Room to not be adjacent to a Crafting Room, Rec Room, Ritual Room, or Classroom.
[*] Pristine is a new keyword that requires a Room to not contain any -Luxury items.
[/list]
[h2]Gnosis Shards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gnosis Shards can now be obtained from sources other than Mages departing from the school.
[*] Gnosis Shards can be gained from Battle Rewards.
[*] New Gnosis Veins in the Underschool can be Mined for Gnosis Shards. Some previously explored Underschool rooms gain Gnosis Veins.
[*] When Mages gain a Magic Skill Level, they drop Gnosis Shards.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay and Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scars gained from expired Trauma now reduce the amount of time available to Revive a Mage that is At Death's Door.
[*] Trauma, Scars, and their impact on the Death Timer are now displayed on the Mage Sheet UI.
[*] Discordance Conviction impact does not begin until you have two more Staff than previously.
[*] Croa Nests are now huntable and drop Eyeballs when Hunted.
[*] Certain types of Filth created by Crafting Stations now have two stages. When first created, they will not affect Luxury. After 3 hours, they will become Rancid versions, which have -Luxury and can impact the new Pristine keyword.
[*] XP for hunting the Fog Incarnate grows more linearly instead of by large chunks.
[*] For new schools, the lowest wing in the Underschool is now a Slams Shut wing.
[*] Cursed totems will no longer appear in final rooms of Slams Shut wings.
[*] Mage Skill now impacts MAGE score more heavily.
[*] The Retire ritual has been renamed to Dismiss. Dismissed Mages do not Manifest a relic.
[*] The Retire Emeritus Ritual is now Retire and does Manifest a relic. It still requires 14 days in the school as Staff.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to place Furnishings on Construction Blocks before the blocks have been Constructed. Furnishings placed this way cannot be Assembled until the blocks are complete, however.
[*] Construction Blocks and Furnishings can now be placed on top of wild plants. The plants will be destroyed when Construction or Assembly is complete.

notes.title: The Breathstealer
notes.content:
This update introduces The Breathstealer, a new late game event where a slow moving, incredibly tough creature marks a Mage for death and stalks them.

There are also quite a few balance changes, fixes, and quality of life improvements, including new UIs for Inventory/Resources and Allowed Meals.

We continue to make progress on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1270580/view/4195747069378942127?l=english]development roadmap[/url] as well. Thanks so much for all the support and feedback. 

[h1]Update Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Breathstealer Event: A new late game event where a slow moving, incredibly tough creature marks a Mage for death and stalks them.
[*] Mages will take the Conviction impact of Quirks into account when choosing a meal.
[*] Fog Incarnate waits longer before moving vertically, giving more time to Hunt when targeting high rooms.
[*] If a Mage with a Social Quirk performs the required Task (Recreation, etc.) in the same room as their Quirk partner, then does it without them, they no longer have their positive Conviction status replaced with a negative status.
[*] The Learning Need no longer adds the Purposeless negative Conviction status.
[*] Sleeping in beds that have a floor (or some other construction) directly above the mattress is no longer allowed.
[*] Broom racks are always considered an entrance to a room, even if there's only one broom rack in the school.
[*] Apprentices can now Hunt.
[*] No longer allowed to move horizontally or diagonally from ladder to ladder. (Sorry, Robbie)
[/list]

[h2]Death's Door Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Re-balanced Death's Door to make it more interesting. (aka harder)
[*] Death's Door timer starts lower for Hopeful Horizons and Tenacious Trials
[*] Each Trauma now lowers the default Death's Door timer by 1/2 instead of 1/3.
[*] Each Scar now lowers the default Death's Door timer by 1/3.
[*] The Revive Ritual does not stop the Death's Door timer unless a Mage is actively doing the Ritual, not just starting to walk to it.
[/list]

 
[h2]XP Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hunting Fog Incarnates grants XP.
[*] Classrooms now increase XP gain for Student Learning.
[*] Combat XP rewards are 2.5x bigger.
[*] Casting XP outside of combat is gained 2x faster at 1 Skill and scales up +1x per Skill level.
[*] XP from performing rituals is larger for all rituals.
[*] Battle XP is now consistent across all enemy parties at a given level.
[*] The scale of XP in the game has been divided by 10 to make all the numbers smaller. This should not affect current progress and is compatible with current saves.
[*] Increased Hunting XP reward for Fog Incarnation to be similar to a high level battle.
[/list]

[h2]QoL[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Allowed Meals UI.
[*] New Inventory and Resources UI.
[*] Add info on Mage Sheet showing progress toward Fully Trained.
[*] Inventory/Resources: Ability to shift-click on category heading to select all in category.
[*] Show effects of wand upgrading at Wand Transfigurator.
[*] Show Discordance changes as an Effect for Hire and Retire rituals.
[*] Add search and show-all to Tutorial UI.
[*] Alphabetize the topics on the Tutorial UI.
[*] Added a conditional for Quirks to Groups. Any existing Group rules that referenced statuses from Quirks have been replaced.
[*] Support for scaling UI on tooltips and Mage portrait area individually.
[*] Add find functionality to Room Types UI.
[*] Improved hover text for Relics to reflect their equip/attune state.
[/list]
 
[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix Hallway Runners built before a school's first save/load.
[*] Rampage break Mage art has animations for Broom riding.
[*] New Crystals resource category for...Crystals.
[*] Fix behavior of shift-click on categories and individual entries in inventory/resources.
[*] Remove Spectral Rifts from Wilds panel.
[*] Remove plants that are in crops (planters, plots) from the inventory display which showed up as duplicates.
[*] Added additional search keys for Research.
[*] Added tooltips for Fully Trained widget on the Mage Sheet.
[*] Fix staff corpse showing up in Resources filter on game start.
[*] Fix wrong checkbox state for categories in Resources filter window when category is collapsed. 
[*] Updated Quirks text to clarify that they require recreating or eating in the same room, not at the same Enchantophone or Table.
[*] Gnosis Shard description now shows where they can be found.
[*] Updated names and descriptions of Social Quirks to make them not be perceived as Positive Quirks.
[*] Added Ethereal and Creatures categories for Inventory.
[*] Breaks have been re-contextualized to be about Magic overwhelming a Mage due to their lack of Conviction. Visuals and text have been updated.
[*] Improved Runaway Break presentation.
[*] For tutorials, show only up to the most recent 6 in the feed.
[*] Fix to Remove button sometimes having the wrong position in Storage content selection.
[*] Fix clicking not properly cycling through all objects when in Storage. 
[*] Fix the pulse animation when selecting items in Storage.
[*] Fixed a bug where Poltergeist events could happen when they were not intended to.
[*] Fix bug that allowed the Croa sounds to carry over into combat.
[*] Fix potential bug when Broom travel destination is actual path destination
[*] Fix Skill history, shown in wand area of Mage Sheet, not being transferred from Student to Adult on hire.
[/list]

[h2]Twitch Integration[/h2]
[list]
[*] Default sorting of name queue is now by the time that viewers use name command.
[*] Allow reordering of the name queue by bit donations or viewer type or a combination of either.
[*] Added the option to allow gifting of names of other viewers.
[*] Added option to restrict gifted name to be name of actual twitch viewers, or arbitrary names.
[*] Added option to restrict gifted names to require bits. 
[/list]
